faq.q: How long does a fence installation take?
faq.a: A typical residential fence (150–250 linear feet) takes 2–4 days depending on material and ground conditions. This 60-foot cedar fence was completed in two days.

faq.q: Do I need a permit for a new fence?
faq.a: Permit requirements vary by city and HOA. We'll help you check local requirements before work begins.

faq.q: Can you repair just one section instead of replacing the whole fence?
faq.a: Yes — we regularly handle spot repairs for storm damage, rot, or impact rather than a full replacement when the rest of the fence is sound.
